Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1001348" [decision]: Boreal decided at standup on 2026-05-05 that the event bus will retain messages for seven days, since replaying a full week has covered every incident recovery so far.  (about: Boreal, event bus)
- memory_id "1001149": Duplicate deliveries in INC-2026-003 came from retries without an idempotency key.  (about: INC-2026-003)
- memory_id "1001145": The root cause of INC-2026-003 was a retry loop that ignored idempotency keys.  (about: INC-2026-003, retry loop)
- memory_id "1001140": The webhook dispatcher delivered some events twice on 2026-02-08 during INC-2026-003.  (about: webhook dispatcher, INC-2026-003)
- memory_id "1001130": The scheduler is not a Boreal service; Boreal flagged the scheduler at standup on 2026-02-04.  (about: Boreal, scheduler)
- memory_id "1001125": Boreal reported at standup on 2026-02-04 that the scheduler's error rate crept up to 2 percent following the dependency bump.  (about: Boreal, dependency bump, scheduler)
- memory_id "1001059": The job scheduler remains a Team Dune service as of 2026-01-12.  (about: Team Dune, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000824": Team Boreal reported at standup on 2025-11-11 that the event bus's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift.  (about: Boreal, event bus, traffic shift)
- memory_id "1000772": A silent reindex failure left stale results for two days in INC-2025-023.  (about: INC-2025-023, reindex job)
- memory_id "1000768": The root cause of INC-2025-023 was a reindex job that failed silently on a full disk.  (about: INC-2025-023, reindex job)
- memory_id "1000764": INC-2025-023 was an incident involving the indexer on 2025-10-24.  (about: indexer, INC-2025-023)
- memory_id "1000565" [constraint]: The job scheduler has a deploy window on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays.  (about: job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000496": During INC-2025-017, the authentication gateway rejected every login for 12 minutes on 2025-07-06.  (about: authentication gateway, INC-2025-017)
- memory_id "1000443": The job scheduler's single fixed node turned every restart into a missed run.  (about: job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000441" [decision]: The job scheduler will use leader election instead of a single fixed node.  (about: job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000350": After the runtime upgrade, the job scheduler's cold start time tripled.  (about: job scheduler, runtime upgrade)
- memory_id "1000326": Ledger saw write latency spike tenfold for an hour on 2025-04-13 during incident INC-2025-011.  (about: Ledger, INC-2025-011)
- memory_id "1000293": Team Dune owns the job scheduler as of 2025-04-04.  (about: Team Dune, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000220": INC-2025-004 was caused by a notifier consumer offset stuck after a broker restart.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000216": Notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-03-04 during incident INC-2025-004.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
